Thanks,

Team — reviewed the client's marked SOW and prepared a concise redline. High-level: we can accept the temporary top-up and an automatic rollback, but we need to tighten the language around usage reconciliation and overage exposure during the top-up window. Specifically:

- Replace client-proposed open rollback with a deterministic revert on a fixed UTC timestamp (no manual opt-outs).
- Add an ops notice period (48 hours) for enactment of capacity changes to protect scheduling windows.
- For the concession: recommend a billing-credit approach (one-time credit applied to the invoice following the top-up window) rather than altering per-token rates — simpler for accounting and avoids long-term price precedent.

I've attached the redline PDF (Redwood_redline_v1.pdf) and an outline of required Order Form fields we will need to populate. Please review and flag any commercial trade-offs you'd like me to preserve.

Aditya Rao
Senior Counsel (Commercial)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_redline_v1.pdf (PDF, 85KB)
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: Michael Sullivan <michael.sullivan@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 Dec 2028 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Brightline: capacity scale request + proposed SOW edits — draft change order and next steps

Michael — thanks for your patience. Per our internal review (legal + sales ops), Redwood can do the requested +30% capacity for a 90-day window with these commercial mechanics: 

- Mechanic: one-time invoice credit equal to 10% of billed usage across the 90-day top-up window (applied to the subsequent invoice).
- Operational: capacity will be committed from 2029-01-05T00:00:00Z through 2029-04-05T00:00:00Z; revert is automatic at 2029-04-05T00:00:00Z.
- Notice: Redwood requires 48 hours written notice to schedule the capacity change.
- Billing: Updated_OrderForm_v2.xlsx attached shows the credit as a separate line item for accounting clarity.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm you accept the invoice-credit mechanic and the start date.
2) If confirmed, we will issue a change order (DocuSign) with the redline baked in — target to send within 24 hours of your confirmation.

HubSpot/Deal reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890
DocuSign prefill link (for your convenience): https://www.docusign.com/prepare/BRIGHTLINE-DF-2345

If procurement prefers a per-token discount instead of a credit, we can model it but it will add an extra finance approval step and delay the timeline.

Regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
